nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Developer guide for the JARVIS HUD React + TypeScript application (Stage 3 refactor, ADR-010), documenting its src/ layout — data layer, hooks, components, and pages — plus run commands for dev, test, and build, and the graph.json offline/live projection strategy.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Vite entry-point HTML shell for the JARVIS HUD React application; mounts the React root div, loads sci-fi Google Fonts (Chakra Petch, Orbitron, Share Tech Mono, JetBrains Mono, Press Start 2P), and bootstraps main.tsx via ES module script.
nodes.languageNotes: Sets data-theme='jarvis' on the html element, activating CSS custom-property theming without JavaScript.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: NPM package manifest for the el-nino-jarvis-hud React + TypeScript app, declaring Vite/Vitest as the build and test toolchain, React 18 and Cytoscape as runtime dependencies, and scripts for dev server, tsc+vite build, preview, and test runs.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the JARVIS HUD; targets ES2021 with strict mode, bundler module resolution, noEmit (Vite handles transpilation), react-jsx transform, and strict unused-locals/parameters checking covering src/ and config files.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses moduleResolution: 'bundler' and allowImportingTsExtensions, the recommended Vite + TypeScript configuration that delegates emit to Vite while TypeScript handles only type-checking.
